opportunities.title: International Payroll Analyst
opportunities.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Analyst to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

  • International Payroll Execution & Oversight: 
    • Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.
    • Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
    • Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.
  • Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.
  • Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.
  • Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.
  • Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).
  • Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ y

opportunities.description: About the role At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance. As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop. This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation. Your Responsibilities: Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes. GHG reduction calculation : Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes Policy Fit : asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation. Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities. Your profile You recognize yourself in the following: Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship) Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.
